missing_information_behavior: Do not suggest additional zinc until existing product labels, elemental zinc amounts, frequency and relevant medicines are reviewed.
safety_exclusions: Do not confuse zinc gluconate compound mass with elemental zinc amount.
Do not duplicate zinc across multivitamins and standalone products.
Avoid chronic high intake that may cause copper deficiency.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, kidney disease, gastrointestinal malabsorption, prolonged high-dose use or concurrent tetracycline/quinolone antibiotics or penicillamine.
population_and_context: People already using zinc supplements who are considering zinc gluconate or another zinc product; total elemental zinc from all sources must be considered.
dose_constraints: No additional dose from this rule. Reconcile total elemental zinc against age/life-stage reference values and upper limits.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Zinc fact sheet describes elemental zinc, upper limits and interactions; excess intake can impair copper status. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
